status: ENTRY DISABLED — awaiting a validated rule from the Phase-0/Phase-1 research
why_disabled: scripts/v5_intraday_lab.py measured RANDOM intraday entries on XAU at -0.11R (M15 3xATR RR2) to -0.18R (M15 2xATR RR3) per trade net of live FTMO cost. Until an entry beats that empirical baseline with t>=2 and a stable per-year record, arming this bot would automate a measured loss.

_viable_cells_from_phase0.B: M30 stop 2.0xATR RR2 max_bars 48 — random win 35.3%, cost/R 13.3%, time-exits 9%, edge needed +2.42pp
_viable_cells_from_phase0.C: M15 stop 2.0xATR RR3 max_bars 96 — random win 27.5%, cost/R 20.0%, time-exits 6%, edge needed +2.48pp

entry._rejected_cells: H1 and 3xATR/RR3 disqualified — 37-60% of trades exit at the time barrier, so the nominal RR is never realised (the same trap that gave the candle model a 77.8% win rate on +4.9% return)

manage._note: All null = pure fixed stop/target, which is the CONTROL. Phase 2 must prove each rule beats that control on expectancy in R before it is switched on. Cutting losers early raises effective RR but lowers win rate — judge on expectancy only, never win rate.

risk._loss_streak_warning: At RR2-3 with a ~30% win rate, runs of 8-12 consecutive losses are STATISTICALLY NORMAL, not a malfunction. At 0.5% risk that is a 4-6% drawdown and must be survivable by design. NEVER add martingale/recovery sizing — V5_FINDINGS 3l measured it ruining 71-97% of paths even on a positive-edge base.
